trtexec.notes: Inference ceiling for the project engine; not a product competitor.

tuned.configuration: Explicit requests, num_streams, vapoursynth_threads, and cuda_graph values are required.

vstrt.notes: TensorRT 11 VapourSynth target built against the same base and serialized engine as the project.

tuned.configuration: Explicit decode_method (cpu or nvdec) and writer (ffmpeg or nelux) values are required. FP32 bindings and native CUDA Graph remain fixed.

tas.notes: Pinned native TAS TensorRT and video I/O environment, independent of the project runtime. Its upstream builder consumes the canonical mixed-FP16 ONNX with half=false to retain FP32 bindings. Both native writers are normalized to the shared NVENC output contract. Upstream-default describes CPU/FFmpeg I/O, not an otherwise unmodified factory command.
